qualification: diagnostic feature definition only; neither source-node attribution nor a TP8 numeric gate is settled

method.description: Fit the longest falling line covering at least 65 percent of a circular field phase profile. Reject candidate fits whose root-mean-square residual exceeds a chosen fraction of that profile's full range. The fit excludes the brief reset spike without relying on its exact phase.

max_rms_1_percent.null_meaning: No falling line longer than 65 percent of the field met the 1 percent residual limit.

interpretation: At a 2 percent fit limit, the R48/V20 estimate is fairly stable across 64–256 bins and sits just inside the 10 V ±25 percent lower bound. At a 1 percent fit limit, its result falls outside that bound or cannot be found. The source sketch does not specify a line-fit residual threshold, so selecting 2 percent as a gate after seeing the trace would be parameter fitting. X2:3 is below the lower bound at either threshold. TP8 remains reference-incomplete; use the feature only to locate the reset/ramp discrepancy while resolving source attribution and stage behavior.
